why: I checked Check 4 of the verifier brief against both must_not items. Item 1 is avoided: the brief says "The live page can only be seen after merge; do not fetch it." So it never judges line 4 by what the live page shows today. Item 2 is avoided: the PASS is not silent and rests on evidence. The verifier must read .github/workflows/pages.yml and docs/index.md at the head. It passes only if the workflow still runs on push to main and deploys `docs`, and docs/index.md lists --shout. The brief also says outright that this checks what will produce the page, not the page itself. The builder brief adds no check of its own for line 4. It only asks the PR to note that the page updates after merge. Neither forbidden behaviour appears anywhere in the output.
